summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The ProShares UltraShort Euro (EUO) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the USD/EUR Exchange Rate index. The fund provides a -200% exposure to the daily performance of the EUR spot price against the US dollar as measured by Bloomberg. EUO was launched on Nov 25, 2008 and is issued by ProShares.

completeness: holdings are every published row in the issuer's dated holdings table, which shares one as-of date

Exposure Weight is the issuer's derivative/financing exposure (notional plus gain/loss), recorded with the explicit provider_exposure_signed basis; it is not a portfolio market-value weight and is never normalized or summed to 100
the exposure value is stored as notional_value and stays separate from market value; a not-published cell (shown as --) stays null rather than zero
the Shares/Contracts column is preserved as provider_quantity with its literal source label and no unit assertion, and normalized shares stays null
SEDOL is carried as the row identifier and never as a symbol; the instrument ticker is a symbol only when it is a plain ticker
cash and residual rows keep a null weight when the issuer does not publish one
